newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Stg to recover more, cable targets $1.6380.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Stg to recover more, cable targets $1.6380.

text.p: After this week's seven pfennig shakeout sterling is set to recover further on the European crosses with cable set to target the $1.6380 congestion area, technical analysts said.
"Look for a sterling recovery on the crosses today," said Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank. "Cable should aim for $1.6380 with $1.6160 to hold."

At 0710 GMT sterling was at 2.7720/30 marks having clawed its way up from minor resistance around 2.7600 overnight. Cable was at $1.6254/64 against a previous $1.6195/00. The $1.6200 level represents a 50 percent retracement of the mid-march to early April upmove.

On the upside for cable $1.6283 will prove to be mild resistance being the 38.2 percent retracement of the same upmove. But as this level has already been crossed and only stands as a previous resistance level.

$1.6380-$1.6400 will provide far tougher resistance being the area of the top of the range since early April, analysts said. On sterling/mark a wedge formation on the hourly charts and pickup in hourly momentum points to a move higher, technical analysts said.
They are looking for the move through 2.7730 to be sustained and are targeting 2.7930 as the next major point.
But congestion around 2.7740-80 and then again at 2.7800-30 will bar the way.
RSI - 14 day: Sterling/mark: 46 pct, sterling/dollar: 51 pct
